claims: WrestleMania 42 takes place on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place on Sunday, April 19, 2026.
WrestleMania 42 takes place at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas, Nevada.
WrestleMania 42 begins around 6 p.m. ET on both nights.
WrestleMania 42 begins around 3 p.m. PT on both nights.
Night 1 main event at WrestleMania 42 is Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton for the Undisputed WWE Championship.
Night 2 main event at WrestleMania 42 is CM Punk vs. Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship.
WrestleMania 42 includes Women’s World Championship match between Stephanie Vaquer and Liv Morgan.
WrestleMania 42 includes Women’s Intercontinental Championship match between AJ Lee and Becky Lynch.
WrestleMania 42 includes a Women's Tag Team Championship Fatal 4-Way.
WrestleMania 42 is available on ESPN in the United States.
WrestleMania 42 is available on Netflix internationally.
